g.title: scripts/snr_corpus.py Per-cell SNR metrics over the pyali corpus outputs -- README section 9, stage 1 of 3.
scripts/snr_aggregate.py Aggregate the per-FOV SNR metrics into one table plus roll-ups -- README section 9, stage 2 of 3.
scripts/snr_figures.py Violin figures over the SNR summary tables -- README section 9, stage 3 of 3.
scripts/snr_sta.py Per-cell and per-FOV spike-triggered averages -- README section 10f, stage 1b of the SNR pass.
scripts/snr_sta_figures.py Aggregate and plot the spike-triggered averages -- README section 10f, stage 3b.
scripts/snr_sta_variance.py Make between-cell STA variance visible -- README section 11, Task 1.
scripts/representative_traces.py Representative single-cell traces at the 5th / 50th / 95th percentile of each SNR metric.
snr_analysis/snr/snr_compare.py Quantitative high-frequency SNR comparison of TWO pyali runs on the SAME movie.
